rolled oats.name: Rolled Oats
rolled oats.whatItIs: Whole oat groats that have been dehusked, steamed, and rolled into flat flakes.
rolled oats.whyUsed: Provides sustained low-glycemic complex carbohydrates and natural satiety.
rolled oats.whatToKnow: Rich in beta-glucan soluble fibre, scientifically shown to help manage LDL cholesterol.

milk.name: Pasteurized Milk
milk.whatItIs: Wholesome bovine milk containing natural whey and casein proteins.
milk.whyUsed: Provides complete amino acids, calcium, and dairy fats for texture and nourishment.
milk.whatToKnow: Natural source of bioavailable calcium, riboflavin, and high-biological-value protein.

curd.name: Curd / Dahi
curd.whyUsed: Provides protein, probiotics, and creamy mouthfeel.
curd.whatToKnow: Fermentation naturally breaks down lactose and enriches gut microflora.

paneer.name: Fresh Paneer
paneer.whatItIs: Fresh cottage cheese coagulated with natural food acids.
paneer.whyUsed: Dense protein and dairy calcium source.
paneer.whatToKnow: Excellent vegetarian complete protein; high in natural saturated dairy lipids.

almonds.name: Almonds
almonds.whyUsed: Adds rich crunch, protein, and heart-healthy monounsaturated fats.
almonds.whatToKnow: Packed with vitamin E, magnesium, and dietary fibre.

cocoa solids.name: Cocoa Solids
cocoa solids.whatItIs: The non-fat component of chocolate liquor derived from fermented cacao beans.
cocoa solids.whyUsed: Provides authentic chocolate flavour, dark color, and aroma.
cocoa solids.whatToKnow: Contains beneficial polyphenol and flavonoid antioxidants.

citric acid.name: Citric Acid (INS 330)
citric acid.whatItIs: Natural organic acid naturally present in citrus fruits.
citric acid.whyUsed: Controls acidity, balances sweetness, and extends shelf freshness.
citric acid.whatToKnow: Standard, thoroughly evaluated regulator widely recognized as safe globally.

soy lecithin.name: Soy Lecithin (INS 322)
soy lecithin.whatItIs: Natural phospholipid blend extracted from soybean oil.
soy lecithin.whyUsed: Prevents fat and water from separating, providing smooth blending in chocolates and bakery.
soy lecithin.whatToKnow: Natural plant-derived lipid; allergy warning applies only to individuals with severe soy allergies.

raising agents.name: Raising Agents (INS 500ii, INS 503ii)
raising agents.whatItIs: Sodium bicarbonate and ammonium bicarbonate food-grade baking salts.
raising agents.whyUsed: Releases carbon dioxide micro-bubbles during baking for light, crispy texture.
raising agents.whatToKnow: Dissipates cleanly during oven baking, leaving standard trace mineral residues.

iodised salt.name: Iodised Salt
iodised salt.whatItIs: Food-grade sodium chloride fortified with micro-nutritional potassium iodate.
iodised salt.whyUsed: Essential culinary seasoning and microbiological stabilizer.
iodised salt.whatToKnow: Supports thyroid hormone synthesis, but daily intake should stay within WHO <2000mg sodium targets.

liquid glucose.name: Liquid Glucose / Glucose Syrup
liquid glucose.whatItIs: Concentrated aqueous solution of nutritive saccharides obtained from starch hydrolysis.
liquid glucose.whyUsed: Prevents sugar crystallization in confectioneries, boosts chewiness and moisture retention.
liquid glucose.whatToKnow: Rapidly digested simple carbohydrate with a high glycemic index.

maltodextrin.name: Maltodextrin
maltodextrin.whatItIs: Water-soluble polysaccharide produced from vegetable starch by partial enzymatic breakdown.
maltodextrin.whyUsed: Bulking agent, carrier for flavor powders, and mouthfeel improver without intense sweetness.
maltodextrin.whatToKnow: Has a high glycemic index (GI 85–105) despite not tasting overtly sweet on the tongue.

invert sugar.name: Invert Sugar Syrup
invert sugar.whatItIs: Equimolar mixture of glucose and fructose produced by splitting sucrose.
invert sugar.whyUsed: Retains moisture in biscuits and snacks, preventing them from drying out or staling.
invert sugar.whatToKnow: Acts metabolically just like refined sugar; contributes directly to total added sugars.

refined wheat flour.name: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida)
refined wheat flour.whatItIs: Finely milled wheat flour stripped of both its fibrous bran shell and germ layer.
refined wheat flour.whyUsed: Provides soft, elastic crumb structure and long ambient shelf life.
refined wheat flour.whatToKnow: Rapidly digested starch with minimal intrinsic fibre or micronutrients compared to whole grains.

palm oil.name: Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil / Palmolein)
palm oil.whatItIs: Tropical plant oil pressed from the mesocarp of oil palm fruit.
palm oil.whyUsed: High oxidative stability at frying temperatures and low cost with semi-solid mouthfeel.
palm oil.whatToKnow: Comprises ~45–50% saturated palmitic fatty acids. Best consumed in moderation.

flavour enhancer.name: Flavour Enhancer (INS 635 / INS 621)
flavour enhancer.whyUsed: Intensifies savory umami flavor profiles in noodle seasonings and extruded snacks.
flavour enhancer.whatToKnow: Encourages over-consumption of hyper-palatable snacks. Best enjoyed occasionally.

caramel color.name: Caramel Colour (INS 150d)
caramel color.whatItIs: Deep brown coloring manufactured by heating carbohydrates with sulfite and ammonium compounds.
caramel color.whyUsed: Provides dark brown hue in colas, sauces, and confectionery.
caramel color.whatToKnow: Purely cosmetic synthetic additive without any nutritional value.

phosphoric acid.name: Acidity Regulator (INS 338 / Phosphoric Acid)
phosphoric acid.whatItIs: Inorganic mineral acid used exclusively in dark colas.
phosphoric acid.whyUsed: Imparts sharp tangy bite and preserves beverage stability.
phosphoric acid.whatToKnow: High consumption of dietary inorganic phosphates can affect calcium-phosphorus bone balance.
